# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/focus_compiler.mjs) from docs/design/focus/regional_sensai.json. Do not edit.
zin_regional_sensai_centre_lean = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_regional_centre_half = zin_leren_lean }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_regional_centre_half = -0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_regional_centre_half }
	zin_leren_add_lean = yes
}

zin_regional_sensai_call_crowns = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_region_north_lands
			NOT = { zin_is_lerendor = yes }
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			is_in_faction = no
			check_variable = { zin_leren_lean > -41 }
			check_variable = { zin_leren_lean < 41 }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_regional_sensai.5 }
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_regional_sensai_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_regional_sensai_friendship
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_regional_sensai_friendship
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 2 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_regional_sensai_kept_faith
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_regional_sensai_kept_faith
			}
		}
	}
}
